repo_state_at_start: main @ cdf62fd (22 dataset-B rows, 19 dataset-A products, 10 sellers, 13 retailers)
method: Every URL below was opened live with a page reader on 2026-10-22 (no cached copies, no search-result snippets, no memory of an earlier fetch). Each value stored in this repository for that target was then searched for in the returned text. A value that was found verbatim is 'confirmed'. A value that was wrong, unsupported, or missing where the source does state it is 'corrected' and the correction is recorded with the quote that justifies it. Something true but adverse is 'flagged'. Nothing was averaged, rounded up, or filled in from what a retailer usually says.
no_hallucination_rule: The rule printed in the site's front-page banner governs this file: every number was read off an official seller or government page and is linked; where a seller does not publish a value the cell is empty and flagged, never filled in with a guess. This pass applied the rule in both directions — it also deleted a number that a source did not support (the 3% fee wrongly attributed to Sarraf, F15) and corrected a claim that a source contradicted ('no ring weight on the listing' where the listing prints 5.5-8.5g, F14).

not_edited_change_requests_instead: scripts/*.py, scripts/*.js, .github/workflows/audit.yml — inside open PRs #20 and #22
every *.html page — written only by scripts/build_site.py, which is inside both open PRs' diffs
scope.reason: Two PRs (#20 arena/8aaa18bf-gold3, #22 arena/e6fe3e4f-gold3) were open and being pushed while this pass ran, and they touch those files. The board's rule is to log a change request rather than edit inside another session's scope, so this pass kept to files in neither diff and left the rest as CR-1..CR-7 in COORDINATION.md §4.
